title: Act: Wire round loading/error state and HeaderOverlay into App
summary: Add loading/error state and header prop in App.
description: Track loading and error, pass HeaderOverlay to GameLayout header.
acceptance_criteria: Header receives round, loading and error.
definition_of_done: App renders HeaderOverlay in header slot

steps.action: Add useState<boolean> loading initialised true and useState<string|undefined> error. Replace the effect body so it calls getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))).finally(() => setLoading(false)). Import HeaderOverlay from './components/HeaderOverlay' and world from './runtime/content'.
steps.code: getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))).finally(() => setLoading(false));

steps.action: Pass header={<HeaderOverlay worldTitle={world.title} round={round} loading={loading} error={error} />} to GameLayout.
steps.code: <GameLayout header={<HeaderOverlay worldTitle={world.title} round={round} loading={loading} error={error} />} scene={...}
